name: Join / Enrich
description: Enrich a list with matching items from another list, correlated by a key — e.g. attach each passenger's flights where flight.paxId = passenger.id. Outputs the left list, each item carrying its matches under a new field.

inputs.name: right
inputs.description: The related list to pull matches from, e.g. $.flights. Leave blank to use the upstream node's output.

params.name: leftKey
params.description: Field on each left item to match on (e.g. id).

params.name: rightKey
params.description: Field on each right item to match on (e.g. paxId).

params.name: as
params.description: Name of the field to attach the matches under (e.g. flights).

enum.label: Collect all matches
enum.description: Attach an array of every matching right item.

enum.label: First match only
enum.description: Attach a single matching right item (or null).
